name: 450W Double Glass Solar Module
tagline: High-Efficiency 450W Double-Glass N-Type Module. The CN450W features premium N-type monocrystalline technology with bifacial double-glass construction, delivering 450W output at 22.52% module efficiency. Optimized for commercial rooftops, industrial projects and distributed generation where long-term yield, mechanical resilience and 30-year linear power warranty matter most.
tech: N-type mono-crystalline silicon · 96 half-cut cells (6×8×2) · 16BB multi-busbar · 2.0+2mm dual-glass construction · IP68 junction box with 3 bypass diodes · Fire Class C
imageAlt: Callsun CN450W double glass bifacial solar module — two panels standing vertically on white background showing front and rear bifacial sides
description: Callsun CN450W is a 450W double glass N-type solar module designed for B2B distributors, dealers and EPC installers who need reliable modules for repeatable rooftop and distributed generation projects. With 22.52% module efficiency, bifacial gain and 30-year linear power warranty, the CN450W delivers bankable long-term performance for commercial rooftops and industrial installations.

specs.label: Output Commitment
specs.value: 87.4% output at year 30 (1% first-year + linear degradation thereafter)

benefits.title: N-Type Technology
benefits.description: N-type cells offer our advanced in-house cell technology with better performance and improved reliability, delivering an exceptional module efficiency of 22.52%.

benefits.title: Bifacial Power Gain
benefits.description: N-Type architecture increases bifaciality up to 80% ± 5% for a higher backside bonus and better lifetime yield, optimized by multi-busbar technology.

benefits.title: Low Temperature Coefficient
benefits.description: Features a highly competitive temperature coefficient (Pmax) of -0.290%/°C for the highest lifetime energy yield in all climates.

benefits.title: Industrial Grade Construction
benefits.description: Optimized dual-glass construction (2.0+2.0mm Tempered Glass) with a silver anodized aluminum alloy frame for the highest mechanical load resistance.

benefits.title: Protected Against All Environments
benefits.description: Certified to withstand humidity, heat, rain, marine environments, wind, hailstorms, and packed snow for reliable global deployment.

benefits.title: Warranty
benefits.description: 25-year product warranty and 30-year linear power warranty (87.4% output at year 30) for maximum long-term investment protection.
